answer_1.quote: Our method builds on GraphRAG with a more sophisticated graph construction technique, called Triple Graph Construction, to generate evidence-based responses... We evaluate MedGraphRAG on several popular open-source and commercial LLMs... The results evaluated across 9 medical Q&A benchmarks show that Med-GraphRAG yields materially better results than classic RAG and GraphRAG.
answer_1.outputs: medical answers with citations and term explanations

answer_2.quote: Performance is measured by the accuracy of selecting the correct option.

answer_4.quote: Our evaluation panel consisted of 7 certified clinicians and 5 laypersons... Raters completed a five-level rating survey for each model's response, assessing responses across five dimensions: pertinence (Pert.), correctness (Cor.), citation precision (CP), citation recall (CR), and understandability (Und.).
answer_4.guideline: rating survey assessing five dimensions: pertinence, correctness, citation precision, citation recall, and understandability
